clue.text: Drink with discontented international broadcaster

clue.text: Was familiar with novel being broadcast

the opening letters of these two words

explanation.definitionFit: Stalwart describes someone sturdy and dependable, a synonym of strong in build or loyalty.

clue.text: Single-minded determination that Stonehenge road planners had?

clue.text: Metal star

the last letter of the word

clue.text: Olympian raising the bar?

taken as written

clue.text: Left relative sandwiches at home

clue.text: Concern for profit
